sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Enu language' and Wikipedia (zh) '西摩洛语', raw wikitext read 2026-09-17.

sources.citation: Hayashi, Norihiko. 2022. Plural markers in Youle Jino and Lolo-Burmese. ICSTLL-55 Abstract Book, Kyoto University.
sources.note: Only hit for Ximoluo in the whole abstract book: cites 'Ximoluo /jo31v33/ [for human] (Dai et al 2009)' as a plural marker; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Hurd, Conrad (with Cathryn Yang & Eric Johnson). 2006. Request for Change to ISO 639-3 Language Code, CR 2006-028 (creation of [enu] Enu). SIL International ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 5 pp. + 3-pp. New Code Request form.
sources.note: Nothing on stress. p.3 (Yang, summarising Dai & Duan 1995): 'Enu has three tones /35, 33, 31/ Biyue and Kaduo have four /55, 33, 31, 35/'; also notes no palatalised stops, extra postalveolar series, /ɣ/. Sources listed p.4: Dai & Duan 1995 Haniyu gailun; Simao shaoshu minzu 1990; Mojiang gaikuang 1986.
sources.venue: SIL International ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 5 pp. + 3-pp

sources.citation: 中央民族大学 少数民族语言文字使用发展保护情况: 哈尼族 page (nmlr.muc.edu.cn/info/1119/2272.htm).
sources.note: Records that the 中国语言资源保护工程 ran a survey '云南墨江哈尼语碧卡方言雅邑乡西摩洛话' and that materials went into 《中国濒危语言志》/other 语保 materials; no published Ximoluo volume located, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: 中国语言资源保护工程 survey '云南墨江哈尼语碧卡方言雅邑乡西摩洛话' (2015-2019 语保 fieldwork; reported by MUC nmlr.muc.edu.cn as deposited in 《中国濒危语言志》 materials / 语保 archive).

sources.note: A recent instrumental-quality recording and description of the same Yayi variety; if a 中国濒危语言志 volume or 语保 report exists it would supersede the 2009 book on prosody.

sources.note: The only book-length description of Enu (Glottolog's sole 'grammar'); its 语音 chapter (声调, 音节结构, 语流音变) is the one place a statement on 重音 (or its absence) would be found; used as source by Grambank and Wiktionary.

sources.citation: 戴庆厦等. 2009. 西摩洛语语言使用现状及其演变 [Language use in Ximoluo and its evolution]. Beijing: 商务印书馆. 230 pp. ISBN 9787100066211.

sources.note: Companion sociolinguistic volume from the same fieldwork; usually opens with a short 语言概况 that may restate the phonology (tones; possibly a line on 重音).

sources.citation: Dai Qingxia 戴庆厦 & Duan Kuangle 段贶乐. 1995. 哈尼语概论 Haniyu gailun [An introduction to the Hani language]. Kunming: 云南民族出版社.

sources.note: Cited by the ISO 639-3 change request as the source of Enu's 3-tone system and of Enu's status as a separate 土语 of the 碧卡方言; a Hani-wide phonology chapter may include a remark on stress covering the Enu variety.

sources.citation: Li Yongsui 李永燧 & Wang Ersong 王尔松. 1986. 哈尼语简志 Haniyu jianzhi. Beijing: 民族出版社.

sources.note: Standard sketch of Hani including the 碧卡方言; Chinese 简志 volumes sometimes contain a sentence on 重音 for the language as a whole; would only bear on Enu indirectly.
